title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: You around to chat about these minor league departures Lynn reported? Need confirmation and to ask why
No we don’t comment on that as you know. Every year there are changes and when we have staff in place we will announce as we always have through our affiliates
Yes, but we are not commenting on it and we are have not ready to announce replacements
Ok, so can you confirm those for me? And can I put Avila declined comment
Littlefield already confirmed it yesterday when he was asked by Lynn. Other than that as I said there is no other comment. We have never commented on staff changes.
What does H. Castro have to improve on in order to be any everyday guy? I have been very intrigued by this kid all year...(no quotes)

I’ve been arguing with someone who calls him an org guy. I think he’s much better than that. Though only 318 ABs, org guys don’t hit .300 in the majors. Might only be a part-time player (super utility who you can plug to patch injuries) but the kid screams “ballplayer” - instincts, feel, mentality - and being that super-util can be very valuable, no?

The scout you said he is an Org is going on past history, Plus analytics Past history is not good either, however, since late last year and last winter ball he has made strides. He is at least a grade 40/45 which is a fringe which could be a super utility player that can play every position and give you a professional AB. He could play himself into a regular role a grade 50 since he is young enough, however, he will have to prove himself every day. Until a history is established. Can’t totally bank on it yet.
